verdict.rationale: Apple's own pages say users can copy images, video, or text on an iPhone or iPad and paste on a nearby Mac (or vice versa), copy and paste between devices, and even copy and paste entire files between two Macs. That directly delivers cross-device copy/paste. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, documented pairing/setup requirements and limitations (proximity, account, size limits).

support.subject: As a power-user, I can copy content on one device and paste it on another paired device

citations.quote: Copy images, video, or text from an app on your iPhone or iPad. Then paste into another app on your nearby Mac — or vice versa.
You can even copy and paste entire files between two Mac systems.
